title: Multi-Task Anti-Causal Learning for Reconstructing Urban Events from Residents' Reports
abstract: arXiv:2603.11546v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many real-world machine learning tasks are anti-causal: they require inferring latent causes from observed effects. In practice, we often face multiple related tasks where the structural dependencies are a hybrid of task-invariant and task-specific mechanisms. We propose Multi-Task Anti-Causal learning (MTAC), a framework for estimating causes from outcomes and confounders by explicitly exploiting such cross-task invariances. MTAC learns a structural equation model (SEM) that factorizes the outcome-generation process into (i) a task-invariant mechanism and (ii) task-specific mechanisms via a shared backbone with task-specific deviations. Building on the learned forward model, MTAC performs maximum A posteriori (MAP) based inference to reconstruct causes by jointly optimizing latent mechanism variables and cause magnitudes under the learned structural model. We evaluate MTAC on the application of urban event reconstruction from reside

translated_title: 基于多任务反因果学习的居民报告城市事件重建方法
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的机器学习任务是反因果的：它们需要从观察到的结果中推断潜在的原因。在实践中，我们经常面临多个相关任务，其结构依赖关系是任务不变机制与任务特定机制的混合体。我们提出了多任务反因果学习（MTAC），这是一个通过显式利用此类跨任务不变性、从结果和混杂因素中估计原因的框架。MTAC学习一个结构方程模型（SEM），将结果生成过程分解为：(i) 任务不变机制和 (ii) 通过带有任务特定偏差的共享主干实现的任务特定机制。基于学习到的前向模型，MTAC执行基于最大后验概率（MAP）的推断，在学习到的结构模型下通过联合优化潜在机制变量和原因强度来重建原因。我们在从居民报告重建城市事件的应用上对MTAC进行了评估。
tldr: 提出了多任务反因果学习框架MTAC，通过学习将结果生成过程分解为任务不变机制与任务特定机制的结构方程模型，并基于MAP推断联合优化潜在机制变量与原因强度，从而从居民报告中实现城市事件的重建。
en_tdlr: MTAC is a multi-task anti-causal learning framework that learns a structural equation model factorizing outcome generation into task-invariant and task-specific mechanisms, and performs MAP inference to jointly optimize latent mechanism variables and cause magnitudes for reconstructing urban events from residents' reports.
